x: Perhaps this is not the most auspicious way to gain new young members but whatever, pleased we are that Peter North made his way to Belgrave Hall in October 1972 and signed on.

Running in a combined Junior and Youth 1500 metre race at Chiswick on June 27th, Belgrave first year Youths Toby Staff and Peter North both ran well to finish 3rd in 4:32.1 and 5th in 4:59.0 respectively.
P.North 2:18.1 JULY 21st 1973 - CRYSTAL PALACE - SOUTHERN COUNTIES AAA OPEN MEETING.
'Heavy Boys' at the Boxing Day Meeting. Left to right - Peter North, Peter Crosbie, Steve Crosbie, Cliff Brooks, John Martin (kneeling), guest, guest, Bill Couzens.

Belated congratulations to PETER NORTH who has gained the Duke of Edinburgh's Silver Award. He is now attempting the Gold Award which involves completing five sections; a residential qualification, where one has to learn to live with others, an expedition, service, physical efficiency involving a se…
Bill Lucas produces, in his inimitable and efficient (forget Peter North) style a handicap for nearly every Bel who's still warm. This list needs simply to be divided into three equal sections.

Eventually the general consensus of opinion is that Bernard should be handicap winner for the week ahead of Peter North. Will they have enough strength left to turn out for the Club on Saturday though?

Whilst in the medium pack Peter Gardner, Simon Williamson, Peter North and Brian Marmion have shown great improvement and enthusiasm. Having hopefully sounded a note of encouragement may I quickly add that this is, of course, only just the start and there is a long way to go.
PETER NORTH has qualified for the gold award in the Duke of Edinburgh's Award Scheme - well done! It seems that Peter is the first Belgravian to have gained this award.

Mick Manning, last year's winner of the longer race found it a tough afternoon placing 2nd in the 1,500m after being shunted to 3rd in the two lap event by Peter North who startingly revealed some real fight.
